# `admin.mirror.sync`

Flag a push mirror for a manual sync

Site admins only. Marks the mirror manual-due so the scheduler picks it up on the next pass. Refuses disabled mirrors and throttled repeats.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/mirrors/{id}/sync`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin mirror sync`
- MCP: `admin_mirror_sync`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `id` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
